decisive_items: wide fibroblast proliferation, extremely similar to a fibroma
a well-bordered, slightly enhancing soft-tissue tumor measuring 2.7 × 3.7 × 4.0 cm in the left buccal space
response.rationale: The intraoral incisional biopsy demonstrating wide fibroblast proliferation, extremely similar to a fibroma, provides strong evidence for the diagnosis of fibroma, while the contrast-enhanced CT scan revealing a well-bordered, slightly enhancing soft-tissue tumor supports the diagnosis of a soft tissue tumor, making R1 the champion and R5 the runner-up.

rejected.why: The presence of histiocytes in the fine-needle aspiration biopsy is not specific enough to confirm fibrous histiocytoma.
The clinical presentation of a firm, mobile, non-tender mass is not unique to lipoma.
The location of the mass overlying the parotid gland is not sufficient to confirm a benign salivary gland tumor.
